items.summary: Delhi Police's Intelligence Fusion and Strategic Operations (IFSO) unit registered more than four FIRs against social media handles allegedly spreading false narratives and vitiating the atmosphere during the SIR protests. Police said several Pakistani handles were identified spreading anti-India sentiments — on Oct 10 they allegedly circulated false reports claiming deaths during the protests, and users operating from Pakistan are circulating fake videos and misleading news while posing as Indians. Around 500 social media posts have been taken down so far for allegedly spreading rumours or trying to create unrest. This is separate from the already-logged four FIRs over Monday's INDIA bloc march (Connaught Place, Tilak Marg, Barakhamba, Mandir Marg for BNSS Section 163 violations).
items.title: Delhi Police IFSO registers 4+ FIRs over fake online posts during SIR protests; Pakistani handles identified, ~500 posts taken down
